summary.whatChanges: When cloning a Hono request whose body was already consumed as FormData, the clone now also strips the stale `Content-Length` header (in addition to `Content-Type`), letting the runtime regenerate headers for the re-serialized multipart body. A test covers the new behavior.
behaviorChanges: Cloned requests with FormData bodies no longer carry the original Content-Length header
Re-serialized multipart clones get runtime-generated content headers, avoiding a length mismatch with the new boundary
risks: Downstream consumers or middleware that relied on Content-Length being present on cloned FormData requests will now see it missing
Only applies when the cached body is a FormData instance; other consumed body types still keep the original Content-Length
